title: Entorno de pruebas completo y profesional para produccion
description: Construir infraestructura de testing de maxima calidad: (1) cobertura de codigo con @vitest/coverage-v8 y thresholds; (2) tests unitarios, de integracion, de componentes (jsdom + Testing Library), e2e (Playwright multi-browser), a11y, API routes; (3) scripts npm completos, configs estrictas de vitest/playwright; (4) pipeline CI opcional; (5) documentacion QA profesional

classification.rationale: Classified as COMPLEX complexity. Complexity drivers: 15 files affected, cross-cutting (multi-domain), category requires council. Required agents (7): architect, backend, qa, release, infrastructure_bootstrap, infrastructure_guardian, memory_engineer.

decisions.rationale: Infraestructura de testing estandar y profesional: vitest + coverage, playwright multi-proyecto, jsdom. Sin cambios de esquema ni riesgo de produccion.
Tests de integracion sobre runtime, sales, knowledge, channels con mocks existentes; no altera API de produccion.
QA lidera la construccion: define gates, configs, thresholds de cobertura, scripts npm y documentacion profesional.
Sin cambios de produccion; testing infraestructura solo. Commit unico atomico al final.
Validara entorno post-instalacion: node_modules consistente, tsconfig, configs vitest/playwright resolubles.
Se documentara la infraestructura de testing en memoria de ingenieria: configs, comandos, decisiones.
